scope: All six concept areas implemented and evaluated. Images contain illustrative data; running views use captured data and explicitly unavailable states.
evaluation: Inspected original references and successive browser screenshots; made scoped layout and interaction corrections, then repeated the real browser workflow.

areas.name: Inspection workspace
coverage: Scene tree and shared inspector
Identity, relationships, fidelity, changes and actions
Live viewport slot and recorded timeline
Picking, camera focus and projected bounds
corrections: Matched three-column proportions
Compacted relationship groups
Removed HUD from expanded workspace
Kept bounds inside viewport and clear of modal controls

areas.name: Performance investigation
coverage: Observed CPU submission chart and renderer counters
Recorded frame navigation
Actual relation paths without inferred per-object blame
Timing baseline comparison
corrections: Removed duplicate navigation and lower timeline
Preserved space for lower comparison section
Only connected graph edges appear in relation paths

areas.name: Memory and assets
coverage: Resource lifecycle and captured storage history
Scrollable resource table with search/kind/fidelity filters
Weighted shared-resource attribution and dependency navigation
Loading-evidence table and explicit unavailable state
corrections: Capped table height to expose dependency and loading panels
Preserved keyboard focus and table scrolling
Unavailable storage never displays zero as a measurement

areas.name: Traces and regressions
coverage: Two independently validated trace files
Real marker/frame alignment and range filtering
Captured property differences and before/after inspector
Side inspection, user navigation, bookmarks and history-loss reporting
corrections: Compact left comparison rail
Summarized entity additions/removals
Bounded difference table height
Separated relation groups to prevent overlap
Before/after values placed near inspector identity

areas.name: Shader and pipeline analysis
coverage: Observed runtime WebGL source, programs and material variants
Useful feature defines and observed users
Read-only token-colored vertex/fragment source with copy
Explicit pipeline descriptors/attachments and compilation evidence
corrections: Added the secondary scene/material tree
Bounded feature defines and long tables
Kept full source in the source viewer
Pass links require captured edges
Uninstrumented boundaries and timing remain unavailable

areas.name: Interaction surfaces
coverage: Picking/selection toolbar and bounds
Workspace and host-owned dock target
Compact draggable/resizable overlay and Alt passthrough
User-initiated same-origin trace window
Commands, file drop/import and shared selection
corrections: Gave interaction sheet the full content area
Made four panels distinct and connected to working actions
Reduced overlay to a compact inspector
Fixed docking without an explicit target
Fixed F2 tracking after launcher reopening
Rechecked 887x998 layout

checks: All six views reachable and captured
Search focus and shader stage switching
Dock, overlay drag, popup lifecycle, commands
Two real trace exports/imports, marker alignment, property diff, bookmark
Offline navigation across all core views
Historical frame restores visible=true and Latest restores visible=false

limits: GPU and shader-compilation timing require authoritative instrumentation and remain UNAVAILABLE here.
Loader decode/upload timing and uninstrumented pass boundaries remain UNAVAILABLE.
Geometry storage and equal-share resource attribution are ESTIMATED.
Trace window uses the public Lens in the same-origin opener; this is not a remote cross-origin transport implementation.
The six concepts are visual/product references rather than fixed sample measurements or a guarantee of identical raster pixels.
